meta.title: Classrooms
meta.description: Classrooms at XLRI Delhi-NCR: tiered lecture theatres for the case method and discussion rooms, each with projectors and boards.

title: Classrooms
intro: Tiered lecture theatres for the case method, and rooms laid out around tables for group discussion — every one with projectors and boards at the front.

photos.alt: A tiered lecture theatre with curved desks facing twin projector screens and a green board
Rows of curved desks and leather chairs rising toward the back of a classroom
A discussion room with round tables and chairs in front of a board and screen
A classroom from the side, desks curving around the front

highlights.title: Tiered lecture theatres
highlights.text: Curved, rising rows keep every seat facing the front — built for the discussion of the case method.

highlights.title: Discussion rooms
highlights.text: Round tables for group work, syndicate discussions and smaller classes.

highlights.title: Teaching technology
highlights.text: Twin projector screens, whiteboards and green boards in every room.

related.label: Computer Labs
related.description: Rows of workstations for hands-on work with business software.

related.description: A gigabit fibre backbone, 1500 Mbps of bandwidth and campus-wide access.

related.label: Conference Rooms
related.description: Boardrooms and meeting spaces for faculty, guests and committees.
